parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Vertical yaw axis carries the horizontal trunnion frame, following Sperry US1982637.

parts.name: Heading indicator pivot bearings
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Paired pivots on the stated support axis; race and jewel sizes inferred.

parts.name: Heading horizontal-trunnion frame
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Horizontal fore-aft trunnions support a transverse horizontal-spin rotor.

parts.name: Heading indicator pivot bearings
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Paired pivots on the stated support axis; race and jewel sizes inferred.

parts.name: Heading indicator rotor
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Air-driven bucketed rotor. Rotation is slowed for inspection, not operating RPM.

parts.name: Heading indicator pivot bearings
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Paired pivots on the stated support axis; race and jewel sizes inferred.

parts.name: Heading indicator drive air nozzle
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. Nozzle directs suction-induced airflow onto peripheral rotor buckets. Passage geometry is reconstructed.

parts.name: Heading compass drum attached to vertical ring
parts.description: Reconstructed from Heading indicator mechanism-layout drawings; exact proportions and dimensions are inferred. The patent compass scale is carried by the vertical ring. The front-facing teaching dial is a separate display adaptation.

sources.title: Directional Gyroscope, US Patent 1,982,637 A
sources.publisher: United States Patent Office; inventor Bert G. Carlson, assigned to Sperry Gyroscope Company, Inc.
sources.type: Expired primary patent; drawing sheet and descriptive text
sources.use: Primary design disclosure, not a parts breakdown or proof that the patented construction exactly matches each AN 5735-1 serial/configuration. The actual specimen patent stamping strengthens family linkage only.
sources.locator: PDF p. 1 has Figs. 1-5: face, vertical section, orthogonal section, nozzle detail, and single-jet variant. PDF pp. 2-3 describe the assembly and air/erection behavior.
